compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from the MortPlayer Audio Books app, specifically within the "Often Used Preferences" section. The main content of this screen is a dialog box titled "Sorting of tracks," which provides various options for sorting audio tracks. The available sorting options include:

1. Smart (currently selected)
2. Filename with numbers
3. Filename alphabetically
4. Tags
5. Track no.
6. File date (oldest first)
7. File date (newest first)

At the bottom of the dialog box, there is a "Cancel" button to exit the sorting options without making changes. Additionally, there is an option to "Hide status bar" under the "Main Screen Appearance" section, which is currently checked.
